title: MED+250 production backend contract verification
summary: Read-only production reconciliation, negative authorization probes, the complete regression suite, dependency audits, lint, and Supabase advisors verify the deployed MED+250 backend boundary. Operational health remains deliberately critical because no pharmacy login authority is enabled before named review.

checks.name: Complete backend contract
checks.detail: The live contract returned zero invariant failures, zero PUBLIC function grants, zero mutable privileged search paths, and no missing or unexpected privileged functions or tables.

checks.name: Authorization denial probes
checks.detail: Production rejected an identity bind without named authority and rejected malformed binding input; repository transaction tests cover duplicate, cross-tenant, suspended, and revoked cases.

checks.name: Catalogue and privacy checks
checks.detail: Production reports 23,972 approved images, zero partial galleries, one intentionally blank held product, zero mismatched images, and aggregate-only operational health.

checks.name: Complete automated regression
checks.detail: The final release passed 384 of 384 Node tests and 171 Python tests with one intentional skip.

checks.name: Static and dependency verification
checks.detail: Lint, the performance budget, GitHub free-only policy, npm audit, and the Python advisory audit all passed with zero dependency vulnerabilities.
